notes.title: More Enhancements!
notes.content: Thanks to feedback provided, I have fixed more minor issues and added more in the audio department, included new music and a couple more sound effects. Keep the feedback coming.

notes.title: V1.2 Shortcuts
notes.content: I have added a travel pipe to the start of a run. It will only open every 4th run though but will allow you to get to a different level.

notes.title: Patch one. Onboarding improvements
notes.content: First patch. Given feedback recieved fixed a BIG bug where tutorial isnt starting and a few minor tweaks and improvements.
